items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: another fellow named Jerry was playing at another, and I was playing at a small one during that time.

ctx.x: He was playing piano, but he wasn't interested. He was interested in the billiard. And he was always one of my favorite piano players of that type and style that he used at that time. And the same time that Glover was playing those type of houses which they had then in Louisville, you know, well, Glover was playing at one of the houses, another fellow named Jerry was playing at another, and I was playing at a small one during that time. Because Joe Glover is not much older than I.
No, I guess that... He's... You're about 71 now.
